Chilled prawns in Marie Rose on crisp iceberg.How to make it500g cooked king prawns, peeled5 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp Worcestershire sauce2 drops of Tabasco1 lemon1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded1 avocado, diced1/4 tsp sweet paprikaStir the mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, Tabasco and a squeeze of lemon into a pink sauce.Divide the lettuce and avocado between 4 glasses.Pile on the prawns and spoon over the sauce.Dust with paprika and hang a lemon wedge on each glass.Drifting-in-the-pool crab and cucumber cupsBen is just drifting here in the pool. Lemony crab on cool cucumber rounds with dill.How to make it250g cooked crab meat3 tbsp creme fraiche1 lemon, zested and juiced1 tbsp chopped dill2 telegraph cucumbers1 tbsp salmon roeMix the crab with the creme fraiche, lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, dill and pepper.Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a small hollow in each.Spoon in the crab.Top each with a few beads of roe.Salted almonds from the Taft barOn the house for Mr. Gladstone.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the kitchenMr. Gladstone's room service steak DianeBen signs in at the Taft as Gladstone. Seared fillet steaks in a mushroom cream pan sauce.How to make it4 beef fillet steaks, about 180g each2 tbsp olive oil40g butter2 French shallots, finely chopped150g button mushrooms, sliced60ml brandy2 tsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce150ml thickened cream2 tbsp chopped parsley600g potatoes, cut into thin chipsBake the potato chips with a little oil at 220°C until crisp.Sear the seasoned steaks in the oil until done to your liking, then rest.Melt the butter and cook the shallots and mushrooms until golden.Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then stir in the mustard, Worcestershire and cream.Return the steaks with their juices, scatter with parsley and serve with the chips.Elaine's drive-in cheeseburgerBen and Elaine finally talk at a drive-in. Char-grilled beef burger with cheddar and fries.How to make it600g beef mince4 slices of cheddar4 sesame burger buns4 iceberg lettuce leaves2 tomatoes, sliced1/2 white onion, sliced into rings4 tbsp burger sauce750g frozen shoestring friesBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Shape the mince into 4 patties and season well.Grill over high heat, adding the cheese for the last minute.Build the toasted buns with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and patty, and serve with the fries.Something sweetSanta Barbara runaway wedding cakeElaine runs out on her own wedding. White vanilla sponge with lemon curd and cream.How to make it200g butter, softened200g caster sugar4 eggs200g self-raising flour2 tsp vanilla extract3 tbsp milk250g lemon curd300ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugarBeat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.Fold in the flour, vanilla and milk and split between 2 lined 20cm tins.Bake at 180°C until springy, then cool.Whip the cream with the icing sugar, spread the curd and half the cream between the layers, and cover the top with the rest.DrinksMrs. Robinson's late-night bourbonMrs. Robinson pours Ben a drink. Bourbon on the rocks with a twist of orange.How to make it240ml Kentucky bourbon1 orange4 large ice cubesPut a large ice cube in each of 4 short glasses and pour over 60ml bourbon.Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.A full tank of iced teaBen's car runs dry short of the church.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
